asked.item: why Claude only posts when I type
how to make posting run every morning by itself
automatic posting without a manual trigger (cloud option)

verdict.reason: The help pages directly answer how to make Claude post automatically on a schedule, including the every-morning example.

steps.text: A regular Claude chat only acts when you send a message, so posting stays manual.
To automate posting completely, schedule the run instead of starting it by hand.
Set up a Claude Code Routine, which is a scheduled agent, to run your Blotato posting workflow on a recurring schedule, for example every morning.
Alternatively, use a Managed Agent to run the posting workflow in the cloud on a schedule.
